scope: Two isolated native Safari runs, same exact candidate, both on this Mac. Not phone FPS, thermal or whole-city benchmarks. Times are synchronous main-thread call durations, not measured GPU completion. Cache/driver scheduling differs between runs; do not attribute the full timing ratio to a single change.
verifiedChanges: Exact geometry shared; no bufferData on first visible instance draw
Existing light pool preserves count, no added cabin shader compilations
Actual instance bone texture allocations moved to preparation; after first visible draw has zero textureStorage calls
First draw observed 180ms before, 5ms after; limited diagnostic observation only

remainingColdDrawObservation.interpretation: A cold first authored draw can still cost time after allocation/program preparation. Driver/pipeline cause is a hypothesis, not a measured diagnosis. Additional authored draw preparation is under native parity/timing validation.
